rationale: The original distribution thesis is intact — price remains well below VWAP ($33.74) and under the 9-EMA ($33.51), and the current 5-minute bounce is corrective, on fading volume (6.8k→4.3k), stalling right at the 33.50–33.55 breakdown shelf rather than through it. The invalidation at 33.57 has not been threatened, the risk-off tape (SPY -0.23%, VIXY +0.90%) still favors downside continuation, and from here risk-to-target is roughly 4:1 (stop 33.57 vs. gap-fill 33.16). A flip to long lacks supporting evidence since the bounce has not reclaimed the 9-EMA or shelf, so I hold the short until 33.57 proves the thesis wrong.
